declared_conventions.execution: SymPy exact identities and python-flint Arb interval Taylor with analytic rotating-frame tail bounds; no black-box ODE, quadrature, root solve, finite difference or sampling
declared_conventions.projective_normalization: U=u/u(Q0), Z=partial_lambda U, so U(Q0)=1, U_Q(Q0)=r=-rho(Q0)-x0-1/2, Z(Q0)=0 and Z_Q(Q0)=-s(Q0)
declared_conventions.reference_equation: c_p,QQ=A_0*c_p; c_p(-4)=1 and c_p,Q(-4)=0; c_p is lambda-independent

exact_checks.statement: W(U,c)_Q=-lambda*a*U*c for the lambda-independent reference c.
For r=U_Q(Q0), partial_lambda r=-s(Q0) under U(Q0)=1.
The forcing-tail mass has the exact antiderivative 4*pi^2*exp(3Q/2).
The reference-potential tail mass has the exact antiderivative 18*pi^4*exp(2Q).
The coarse cutoff partition is exact.
The refined cutoff partition is exact.
The deeper cutoff partition is exact.

method_reuse.role: exact-rational parsing, outward interval primitives, coefficient-derivative and whole-step-majorant semantics only; no old result is evidence

non_claim: No absolute actual Gamma_1 value or sign, root continuation/velocity, Weyl function, spectral measure, RAQ or physical claim.
primary_sources: NIST DLMF, modified-Bessel and Wronskian conventions: https://dlmf.nist.gov/10

theorem_guards.hypotheses: The upstream Q0 result excludes zero from v(Q0), so U=u/u(Q0) is defined for its finite projective state.
theorem_guards.scope: The output is Gamma_1/u(Q0), never an absolute actual Gamma_1 value.

theorem_guards.hypotheses: All six-state coefficient derivatives and induced-infinity matrix majorants cover the full kappa/lambda boxes on each exact rational step.
theorem_guards.scope: This is an analytic interval calculation, not a black-box ODE solve.
theorem_guards.theorem: Taylor theorem with whole-step D13 majorant

theorem_guards.hypotheses: The a and reference-potential masses are integrated analytically beyond Q_cut, including the Z forcing contribution.
theorem_guards.scope: The tail radii bound magnitude only; they do not imply a Gamma_1 sign, root or spectral statement.

upstream_results.role: provides root-1 Q0-normalized rho and local projective sensitivity intersections
